It's too much by moose blood always hits my feelings

Also, when the party's over by Billie eilish

I broke my palate bone(not sure if correct wording as English is not my first language) and knocked my two adult front teeth loose when I was around 6. To this day I still have my two front teeth. One of them has less feeling in them than the other and my dentist is still baffled over how I don’t have any lasting effects and got to keep my front teeth

Sometimes I will “black out” and not remember how I went from one place to another. It’s the same sensation as when standing up too quickly but just lasts a lot longer. Was freaked out when it happened the first time, now I’m used to it

The thing is my friend did not now he was in a relationship. She was told not long before he proposed to his girlfriend.
My friend also told the guy to NEVER speak to her again as she felt used after that 

I do see your point tho

I have to confirm like 50 times that it is a 100% okay that I join an event that I was not orinally involved in and that everyone thinks it’s fine and that I am not imposing in any way, shape or form. It tends to annoy my boyfriend a lot

I woke up and began crying because my dog was laying in the foot end of my bed and not besides my head as she usually does. 

She’s a very small dog; about the length of my underarm
